curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Once Cassius stumbles onto the secret code to corporate glory, how far will the uncanny reality behind his promotion push him?
curatedMovie.description: In an alternate present-day Oakland, telemarketer Cassius Green unlocks a magical method for rapid workplace success, only to find his sudden corporate ascent steering him into an unsettling, macabre reality.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Sharp, funny, and surreal with an offbeat edge, demanding engaged attention for date nights or group viewings.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Boots Riley blends sharp comedy with surreal fantasy, turning a rise up the telemarketing ladder into an inventive, thought-provoking ride.
